race.comment: ELLIBABY (6) is racing well. Scored at Yeppoon two back then finished second, beaten a neck, over 1280m at Emerald at the latest appearance three-and-a-half weeks ago. Blinkers added in a positive sign from the stable. COBBO (5) started at $9 last time and ran below expectations, finishing fifth at Dingo over 900m. Meets some better types this time but a win is not out of the question. REPLACE THE ACE (10) returned from a spell three weeks ago when he was beaten 3 lengths into fifth over 1200m at Dingo. Fitter and sure to run well. CRAIGLEA MERIDA (11) was Well in the market last time and duly scored over 1200m at this track. Expected to go close again.
